capabilities: add titles and collapse behavior to code blocks
show line numbers and highlight specific lines
display language indicators and copy buttons
render terminal prompts and result blocks
configure default behavior per feature in settings
disambiguation: Not a syntax highlighter; it adds display options around the code blocks Obsidian already renders.
extras: Features apply to reading view only; the README lists themes with known display conflicts caused by !important rules in theme CSS and explains how to work around them.
intentEvidence: Improve the display of code blocks in reading view with titles, line numbers, line highlights, and more.
problem: Obsidian's code blocks in reading view render as plain blocks without per-block options for titles, line numbers, highlights, or copy controls.

relations.evidence: Inspired from Prism.js's plugin, Better Code Block, Code Block Enhancer.
relations.plugin: Prism.js's plugin, Better Code Block, Code Block Enhancer

summary: Code block enhancer that adds titles, collapsibility, line numbers, line highlights, language indicators, copy buttons, prompts, and result blocks in reading view.
